CustomField.description: Maximum number of days to look back, for messages to report on. E.g. If we want to ignore stalled SMS that have been stalled for more than 5 days, this value should be 5.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Maximum number of days to look back, for messages to report on. E.g. If we want to ignore stalled SMS that have been stalled for more than 5 days, this value should be 5.
CustomField.label: Number Of Days
